_comment: Configuration for the 'event-modeling-agents-watch' scheduled task. Edit this file to change what the weekly watch looks for. The task reads it at the start of every run. Add/remove items freely; keep it valid JSON.
_scope_options: Each watch axis has its own scope. 'focus-only' = capture only items touching the listed topics (a narrow net for on-target material). 'anything-substantive' = capture any notable new post regardless of topic, flagging off-thread items in the report (used for the people watch, where the value is the author, not the keyword match). PER-TOPIC OVERRIDE: a topic may carry its own `scope` field, which TAKES PRECEDENCE over the global `topic_scope` for that topic. This lets the tight EM×agents intersection stay 'focus-only' while the broader design-substrate topics run 'anything-substantive'.

topics.name: Event Modeling × AI agents
topics.description: The intersection of AI agents / agentic systems and Event Modeling (Adam Dymitruk's design method) — not just event sourcing. Keep this net TIGHT: an item qualifies only if it connects agents/LLMs to Event Modeling specifically.
queries: discrete-event / formal specification of LLM agents

topics.name: Event sourcing, DCB, CQRS, vertical slice architecture & business capabilities
topics.description: The design substrate around Event Modeling. Capture ANY substantive new development in these areas, with or without an AI-agents angle (per Dannie 2026-06-14). Flag items that DO connect to agents (extra-relevant) and note when an item is purely off the agents thread. Sub-areas: (1) event sourcing (event stores, projections, replay, aggregates); (2) Dynamic Consistency Boundaries / DCB — the 'kill the aggregate' line of work (Sara Pellegrini, Milan Savić et al.) on consistency boundaries decoupled from aggregates; (3) CQRS (command/query separation); (4) vertical slice architecture (feature slices over layered architecture; Jimmy Bogard lineage); (5) BUSINESS CAPABILITIES / capability-based design — capabilities as stable 'what-not-how' boundaries, capability maps, coupling/cohesion, business architecture, Wardley mapping of capabilities (FLAGGED IMPORTANT by Dannie 2026-06-14).
queries: event sourcing projections aggregates DCB talk
capability-based design bounded context business architecture
business capability map Wardley event modeling
